artifact.name: BSharp Bytecode
artifact.determinism_rule: Equivalent normalized bsharp.meaning.v2 meaning produces byte-identical BSharp Bytecode while creator-facing text remains exact.

sections.name: Deterministic UTF-8 string table
sections.schema: Each record is u32 byte_length, exact UTF-8 bytes, then zero padding to four-byte alignment.
sections.ordering: Mandatory strings bsharp.bytecode.v2, bsharp.meaning.v2, and sha256-bsir-meaning-v2 first; then identifier strings and exact creator-facing text literals in canonical emission traversal order, interned at first occurrence.

sections.name: Referenced Kind families
sections.ordering: Referenced ancestors before descendants; custom Kind definitions, Thing Kinds, and selector Kinds are traversed in stable semantic order; equal candidates use first semantic reference.

sections.name: Starting-world records
sections.schema: Instruction records using START_STATE, START_RELATION, START_VALUE, or START_TEXT_VALUE; no CODE block wrapper.

sections.name: WHEN patterns
sections.ordering: Stable source order. Runtime priority is exact Thing, nearest inherited Kind, then source order.

sections.name: Reactive IF records
sections.schema: condition_operator:u8, operand_count:u8, reserved_zero:u16, operands:u32[], code_block_index:u32, source_order:u32.
sections.ordering: Stable source order. Active state is runtime world state and is not serialized into program bytecode.

sections.name: Ordered action blocks
sections.schema: u32 block_count, then 16-byte block directory entries (block_id, instruction_offset, instruction_length, instruction_count), then aligned instruction records.
sections.instruction_record: opcode:u8, operand_count:u8, reserved_zero:u16, operands:u32[]. Block lengths are authoritative; END in disassembly is not an opcode.
sections.instruction_offset_base: Offset is measured from the first byte of the CODE section.
sections.block_order: All WHEN action blocks in event source order, then all IF action blocks in IF-rule source order.

runtime_semantics.every_kind_order: Thing definition order including inherited members
runtime_semantics.that_kind: One concrete Thing captured by the currently matched event context
runtime_semantics.action_order: Complete each action line over its selected Things before the next action line
if_behavior: evaluate after START and complete event bodies
follow_up_order: append nested events to the end
runtime_semantics.save_rule: BSharp Save remains separate runtime world state and is validated against the normalized program meaning fingerprint.
runtime_semantics.ask_rule: BSharp ASK remains read-only and observes the same settled meaning regardless of source, BSIR, or future BSBC origin.

disassembly.status: diagnostic only; not BASIC# creator syntax

malformed_rejection_rules: text and whole-number value type conflict

v0_1_28_includes: optional source or BSIR fingerprint comparison
v0_1_29_includes: follow-up event queue and loop protection
v0_1_29_excludes: full VM stress and performance hardening

emission.string_order: After the mandatory prefix, intern normalized identifiers and exact creator-facing text literals by role at first occurrence during KIND, THNG, STRT, EVNT, IFRL, and CODE lowering.
emission.kind_order: Add each referenced ancestor before its descendant; preserve first semantic reference among otherwise equal candidates.
emission.code_block_order: All WHEN blocks in event order, then all IF blocks in IF-rule order.
emission.determinism: Equivalent normalized Profile 2 meaning produces byte-identical .bsbc and .bsbc.txt output while preserving literal text exactly.
emission.atomic_output: Binary and disassembly are replaced together; a failed emission leaves no partial pair.

loading.validation: complete structural validation before exposing a trusted in-memory model
loading.trusted_model: deeply frozen, deterministic, isolated, and unavailable on failure
loading.failure_boundary: a rejected artifact exposes no partial model and performs no execution or world mutation
loading.summary: validated identity, profiles, fingerprint, section counts, block counts, and instruction counts
loading.disassembly: diagnostic disassembly is reconstructed from validated binary records and must match committed .bsbc.txt output
loading.meaning_comparison: --against accepts matching .bsharp or .bsir.json and compares sha256-bsir-meaning-v2 exactly
loading.execution_boundary: loader remains non-executing; it validates and exposes a trusted model that BSharp Virtual Machine v0.1.29 executes separately
loading.malformed_fixture_count: 41 deterministic in-memory corruption cases; no loose corrupted binaries
loading.string_roles: identifier entries remain canonical lowercase semantic names; literal entries preserve exact single-line UTF-8 and are validated independently

execution.input_boundary: successfully validated deeply frozen BytecodeLoader model
execution.if_settlement: complete action body, then reactive IF settlement
execution.follow_up_order: IF settlement, then first-created first-run queue
execution.world_isolation: each VM owns an independent mutable world; loaded program stays frozen
execution.reporting: canonical reconstructed wording from semantic bytecode records
execution.save_support: implemented by BASIC# v0.1.30 through deterministic BSharp Save write, validated restore, no START replay, preserved IF active state, and atomic failure recovery
execution.ask_support: implemented by BASIC# v0.1.30 through read-only BSharp ASK over VM Things, Kinds, events, IF rules, world summaries, and save summaries
execution.runtime_parity: source, saved BSIR, and validated BSBC must reach identical settled Profile 2 worlds for equivalent event sequences, including exact text values
execution.hardening: repeated deterministic execution, save/restore/replay cycles, isolated VM worlds, malformed-save recovery, IF-loop protection, and 1,024-event protection
execution.preferred_path_boundary: BSharp VM is the preferred Profile 1 and Profile 2 runtime for .bsharp, .bsir.json, and .bsbc; the reference Ruby runtime remains a protected verification oracle.
execution.source_and_bsir_pipeline: resolved meaning is emitted to BSBC in memory, completely validated, and executed by the BSharp VM without temporary artifacts
execution.reference_runtime_role: explicit --reference-runtime opt-in for diagnostics, conformance, and regression comparison; not the normal creator execution path
execution.shadow_parity_verification: --verify-runtime-parity runs the preferred BSharp VM and reference runtime independently, compares startup, events, worlds, IF state, follow-ups, ASK, Save, restore, and replay, and stops on disagreement
execution.text_values: START_TEXT_VALUE, CHANGE_TEXT_VALUE, and TEXT_VALUE_EQUALS preserve exact creator-facing text through reactive IF, canonical reconstructed wording, BSharp Save, BSharp ASK, source, saved BSIR, save/restore/replay, and shadow parity.
